This '''mission''' was an attempt by [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett]] to recover [[Jango Fett/Legends|his father's]] money on the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]] world of [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].

With [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] captured by security forces, Boba would eventually return to ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]'' with what was left of his father's fortune and seek [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]].

==Prelude==
Shortly before his [[Death/Legends|death]], [[Jango Fett/Legends|Jango Fett]] had gifted his son, [[Boba Fett/Legends|Boba Fett,]] a [[Holobook/Legends|book]] of instructions on how to become a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]], and instructed him not to read it unless he had died. After Jango [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|died]] on [[Geonosis/Legends|Geonosis]], Boba used the book's lessons to guide his first steps in the greater [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]]. The first lesson stated that Boba needed to find [[Count/Legends|Count]] [[Dooku/Legends|Dooku]] to access his [[Galactic Credit Standard/Legends|credits]] and find self-sufficiency.<ref name=":0">[[Boba Fett: The Fight to Survive|''Boba Fett: Fight to Survive'']]</ref> Before his death, Jango Fett had left 600,000 [[Mesarc|mesarcs]] in a [[High-Yield Universal Institutional Savings Account|High-Yield Institutional Savings Account]] at the [[InterGalactic Bank of Kuat]] on [[Aargau/Legends|Aargau]].<ref name=":1">[[Boba Fett: Maze of Deception|''Boba Fett: Maze of Deception'']]</ref> 

Boba searched for the Count on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]], but the Count found him first. He had sent the bounty hunter [[Aurra Sing/Legends|Aurra Sing]] to recover the boy and offered his father's ship, the ''[[Slave I/Legends|Slave I]]'', as payment.<ref name=":0" /> Sing brought Boba to Dooku's [[Dooku's headquarters|underground hideout]] on [[Raxus Prime/Legends|Raxus Prime]] and left with the ship. Dooku claimed that it had been Jango's final wishes for him to take over the raising and training of his son. If Boba proved worthy of the fortune Jango had left for him, then Dooku would hand it over.<ref name=":2">''[[Boba Fett: Crossfire]]''</ref>

It didn't take long for Boba to anger the Count, as he had sneaked out of his quarters and discovered the [[Force Harvester]] dig site before being caught by Dooku's enforcer [[Cydon Prax]]. Dooku claimed the boy knew too much and ordered Prax to execute him, but the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] [[Conquest of Raxus Prime|invasion]] gave him an opportunity to escape. When [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] found Boba, he claimed he was a war orphan and was taken aboard the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship/Legends|assault ship]] ''[[Candaserri]]'' for transport to an orphanage on [[Cloud City/Legends|Cloud City]].<ref name=":2" />

After Aurra Sing left Raxus Prime in the ''Slave I'', she searched the ship's [[Databank/Legends|databank]] and found a detailed treasure map of credit stashes Jango had left around the galaxy. These stashes required Jango's (or Boba's) [[DNA/Legends|DNA]] and a [[Retinal scan/Legends|retinal scan]] to access. She also found the [[filocard]] access card to Boba's fortune in the Bank of Kuat. Aurra tracked Boba to Cloud City and offered him the ''Slave I'' in exchange for fifty-percent of his fortune. Boba had no choice but to accept as he had no credits, no friends, and no possessions aside from his father's helmet.<ref name=":2" /> 

==The mission==
Aurra flew Boba to the [[IBC Arcology (Aargau)|IBC Arcology]] pyramid on Aargau to access his account in the Bank of Kuat. The pair strode to the Customs Central console to verify Boba's identity and get him clearance. Aurra had ignored the [[Three Statutes of Aargau|second law]] of Aargau stating that only citizens were permitted to possess weapons. She was surrounded by security [[Droid/Legends|droids]] and was forced to return to the ''Slave I'' to drop off her [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]]. Boba received clearance since he was unarmed, took his filocard, and made his way across the plaza with out Aurra to a wall of [[Turbolift/Legends|turbolifts]].<ref name=":1" /> 

A clone trooper [[Clone cadet/Legends|cadet]] designated [[9779]] chased Boba down and jumped into his turbolift to return the book he had dropped at Customs Central. The cadet recognized Boba was a clone and asked if his helmet was getting repaired too. Amid the growing tensions between the Republic and the [[InterGalactic Banking Clan/Legends|InterGalactic Banking Clan]], the Republic sent a garrison of clone troopers to Aargau to protect the Republic's financial assets and watch out for [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Separatist]] activity. Clone cadets like 9779 were sent to stable worlds like Aargau to learn firsthand how to patrol and defend. 9779's [[Clone trooper learning helmet|learning helmet]] was damaged, and his [[Clone Commander/Legends|commander]] sent him to the Arcology tech support level to get it repaired. Boba claimed that he was a clone cadet with the designation 1313 and that his helmet was also getting repaired. When the turbolift doors opened at Level Two, Aurra Sing was waiting outside. Boba hid in the crowd of passenger and Aurra snatch 9779, believing he was Boba.<ref name=":1" />

Boba escaped the turbolift and explored Level Two's maze of tunnels containing thousands of banks. A [[Bimm (furred species)/Legends|Bimm]] money exchanger named [[Nuri]] noticed Boba Fett was lost and offered him his assistance. Nuri noticed Aurra Sing searching for the boy near the turbolifts and guided Boba down a hidden passage. He deduced that Boba was on Aargau to convert currency or withdraw currency based on the filocard in his possession and explained that Boba would have to go back up to Level One to find out which bank the access card went to. Boba didn't want to risk running into Aurra again, so Nuri offered to take him to the [[Aargau Undercity|Undercity]] to bypass official channels. Nuri could procure Boba's currency without the complication of running into Aurra, but he would have to take a fee out of the total amount. Boba agreed and the pair took a secret [[Repulsorlift/Legends|repulsor]] capsule down to the Undercity.<ref name=":1" /> 

As they were walking down a street, a figure charged Boba from an alley. Nuri stopped Boba before he could throw a brick at the figure, which was a [[Bothan/Legends|Bothan]] [[Information broker/Legends|information broker]] named [[Hev'sin]]. Hev'sin sold information to Nuri that IBC [[Chairman/Legends|Chairman]] [[San Hill/Legends|San Hill]] was in the Undercity to raise funding for the Separatists through negotiations with the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutts]]. After the broker left, Nuri brough Boba to a barred window containing an illegal banking droid. Nuri ordered the droid to take a 600,000 mesarc fee out of Boba's account, but Boba didn't realize that this was the total amount of his account. Before the transaction could be concluded, Boba remembered that the security attendant at the Customs Console had warned him about black market money changers. Boba seized his filocard from the droid, but 500,000 mesarcs had already been transferred to Nuri. It was then that Nuri revealed his true form, a [[Clawdite/Legends|Clawdite]] [[Changeling/Legends|shapeshifter]]. Nuri told Boba that he could have killed him and kept the card, but he refrained because he admired Boba's courage, the fact that he was young and learning, and because they shared a hatred of Aurra Sing, his rival.<ref name=":1" /> 

After Nuri abandoned Boba, Boba learned the name and location of the bank that held his money from the illegal banking droid. He had no idea how to get there from the Undercity, until he bumped into a [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'lek]]. The Twi'lek reminded Boba of one named [[Bib Fortuna/Legends|Bib Fortuna]] his father had spoken about. Boba followed him in the hopes he could lead him to [[Jabba Desilijic Tiure/Legends|Jabba the Hutt]]. One of the lessons in Jango's book stated that he should find Jabba if he wanted knowledge. The Twi'lek led Boba to a [[Krayt dragon/Legends|Krayt dragon]]-themed gambling den. Boba disguised himself as a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] to gain entry, but he was soon harassed by a table of [[Barabel/Legends|Barabels]] playing [[three-handed solitaire]]. He escaped and hid under a table, but it was then that he spotted Aurra Sing. Aurra approached the Barabels and ask them if they had seen a boy in disguise. Boba felt around the floor for a weapon, and instead found a trap door that he could escape into. After falling into a dark cellar, Boba walked around until he found a grille used to spy on a secret meeting chamber. This chamber was occupied by Chairman San Hill and Jabba's nephew [[Gorga Desilijic Aarrpo/Legends|Gorga]]. Boba was disappointed Jabba wasn't on Aargau and fled back to the trapdoor. He fended off an attack from a [[Kretch insect|Kretch]], but then he ran into IBC [[Vice Chair/Legends|Vice-chair]] [[Kos]] of galactic accounts.<ref name=":1" />

Kos believed Boba was the shapeshifting [[Spy/Legends|spy]] the IBC had been hearing about. Boba confirmed his suspicions and claimed that he had information not even San Hill knew to keep Kos from killing him. Kos was eager to hear, but Boba bargained for his freedom and passage to the Bank of Kuat in exchange for it. Kos brought Boba to his [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] and they flew up a ventilation shaft to Level Two. Once they reached their destination, Boba told Kos that Count Dooku and Tyranus were the same person, and that he had funneled billions of credits to the [[Separatist Droid Army/Legends|droid]] and [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|clone armies]] so he could profit off the war. Kos then pulled a blaster on Boba to silence him, but before he could shoot, Aurra fired on his speeder from a [[Hoverbike/Legends|hoverbike]] below. She had bought citizenship papers in the Undercity that allowed her to carry weapons. Boba took control of Kos' speeder and positioned it so she would blast Kos. He then rammed her bike to disable it and made his way to the Bank of Kuat. The bank security droid accepted his filocard and DNA as entry right before Aurra burst into the bank demanding that the droid stop Boba. Boba warned the droid that he suspected her citizenship papers were forged and retrieved his savings box as Aargau authorities detained her.<ref name=":1" />             

==Aftermath==
While Boba only recovered a fifth of the fortune Jango had left for him, he still had enough credits to buy fuel, provisions, and upgrades for the ''Slave I''. He then made his way to [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]] to seek an audience with Jabba the Hutt.<ref name=":1" />
